items.title: Lou Pallo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2007
items.q: Rickie Lee Jones I played for a few times.

ctx.x: Isn’t she? They would be something, because I love backing up people. That’s always been my thing is to play behind them and try to make them sound as best as I can do for them. Rickie Lee Jones I played for a few times. You’ve heard of her?
